title: Closing thanks and McBee's bass book
summary: Rowe thanks him; McBee hopes to publish his bass technique book.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And we’re better for it. So thank you very much. This has just been two plus hours of fascinating dialogue back and forth. And it makes a unique contribution to our oral history collection. And I hope you have many, many, many more mornings where you meet your bass.

Yeah. I hope so too, yeah. Every now and then it tells me to get the hell out of here, you know, but everything is really very exciting for me now, and I’m hoping to get my book out there, my bass book that I mentioned to you.
I’ve documented the techniques of the bass.
Really for schools, if you will, around the world. And hopefully I can find a publisher which might assist me in getting the book out there, given today’s technology.
I’ve been writing it for about 25, 30 years.
Well thanks again, and best of luck to you.
I appreciate it and the feeling is mutual.
